description: This file defines an interface class 'PeerSignalingHandler' for handling signaling messages in a WebRTC streaming context. It declares a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method 'SendMessage' that takes a JSON message as input, intended for subclasses to implement message sending over a signaling channel.

classes.name: PeerSignalingHandler
classes.description: An interface for objects capable of sending signaling messages to a peer over a signaling channel.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the peer over the signaling channel. Must be implemented by subclasses.
